questions.prompt: The Boston Tea Party protested taxes imposed by which country?
questions.fact: The tea was actually being sold cheaply; the objection was to the principle of the tax, not the price.

questions.prompt: What is the term for the variety of life in an ecosystem?
questions.fact: Systems with more of it generally recover faster from disturbance, because more species can fill a lost role.

questions.prompt: Which country is credited with inventing table tennis?
questions.fact: It began as an after-dinner parlour game using books as a net and a cigar box lid as a bat.

questions.prompt: Which sitcom character worked at a bar called Cheers in Boston?
questions.fact: The bar was based on a real Boston establishment, which still trades heavily on the association.

questions.prompt: Which sea lies north of Poland and Germany?
questions.fact: It is only weakly salty, because many rivers drain into it and its connection to the ocean is narrow.
